messages.content: You identify patterns in complete email texts. Respond with valid JSON.

Please write a BRIEF 15-20 word executive summary of the theme "Review and Decision-Making" as it appears in the following examples.
['Can you honestly help me as your partner?', 'If you are interested, please reply immediately via email address above.', 'I really want to invest in your country and I know that your country is political suitable for a profitable business ventures, I hope that with you, it will be so easy for me to locate a nice business ventures, please I will like you to search diligently for a profitable business ventures that we shall in invest on, so that as soon as the security company release and deliver the consignment to you on my behalf, we shall set up the business immediately.', 'WE Await YOUR REPLY ON YOUR PARTICIPATION, TIME IS OF GREAT ESSENCE TO US.', 'Please treat as highly confidential if in any case you did or did not welcome the idea of this business proposal.', 'If you are ready I will give you all the information needed.', 'If you are capable of assisting with the transfer, please contact me immediately on my above information.', 'You are requested to communicate your acceptance or otherwise of this proposal, through my email.', 'Please review and approve the changes made to your companies RBC Express users in order for them to become active.', 'Please I need your reply urgently to let me know if you are capable to assist me and if you are comfortable with my offer so that we can proceed.']

DO NOT write the summary as a third party using terms like "the text examples" or "they discuss", but write the summary from the perspective of the text authors making the points directly.
Please respond ONLY with a valid JSON in the following format:
{
    "summary": "<SUMMARY>"
}
